_comment: M8.2-M8.4: the movies on FFmpeg (docs/FFMPEG_MIGRATION_PLAN.md sections 2.3, 3 and 6.4), in the release lift (tools/setup_pipeline.py's LIFT_CONFIG, tools/r8_lift.sh). Entry hooks on the eleven call stubs through which the game's movie class calls Bink (tools/movie_inventory.py; the stubs lie outside Bink's range, which config/excluded_code.json lifts as traps): port/native/movie/bink_native.cpp answers every call natively -- the guard is always on, and no call reaches the stub's body (a handle not the native player's is counted as a native path declining, fatal in the native release). Each answer stores the caller's TOC where the stub would (sp + 0x28). Addresses only.

entry_hooks.note: Bink's sound module given, before an open (-> 0x00A56B20)
the sets' planes, before a decode (-> 0x00A56FE8)
the next frame into the next set (-> 0x00A5B158)
is the frame after due too? (-> 0x00A5D960)
the sound's end, after a close (-> 0x00A560E8)
